summary.text: Bryan Fontenot is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 55, representing Lafourche, according to the House member page.
The page lists 2019 as the year elected.
The page lists Bryan Fontenot with committee assignments including Transportation (Highways and Public Works, Vice Chair).

paragraphs.text: The House member page lists Bryan Fontenot's occupation as CEO, Bryco Land Developments.
It lists Bryan Fontenot's education as Thibodaux High School, 1996; Criminal Justice, Fletcher Technical Community College, Present.
The House member page lists Bryan Fontenot's committee assignments as Transportation, Highways and Public Works (Vice Chair); Administration of Criminal Justice.
It lists caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation; Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation; Louisiana Rural Caucus.
